model.title: MORE WATER Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Alex Padilla (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would expand federal support for water recycling and reuse, including allowing funding for feasibility studies, extending the time for certain project approvals, and raising the federal cost-share limit for water recycling projects to $50,000,000 with yearly inflation adjustments. It would also authorize cooperative agreements from fiscal years 2028 through 2032 for habitat and water-quality work at the Great Salt Lake and other saline inland lakes, and for fish habitat, monitoring, and hatchery projects tied to the Sacramento River and Shasta Dam. Finally, it would set up a process to deauthorize Bureau of Reclamation projects that have received no funding for eight years, with interim and final lists published and a two-year window for Congress or sponsors to keep a project active.
